questions.learningObjective: Identify the principal in an administrative chain
questions.stem: In the night handover Nurse Anika notes the district officer acts for the ministry but pursues local goals; who is the principal?

options.text: The ministry, because it delegates authority
The patients, because they receive care
The district officer, because she holds the budget
The nurse, because she reports upward

questions.explanation: The principal delegates authority and bears risk; the district officer is the agent. Patients and nurses are stakeholders, not principals.
questions.hint: Ask who delegates and who executes.
